title: Grateful Dead Live at Richmond Coliseum on 1984-10-06
source: flac16/48kHz; Set 2 Source from Doug Oade: 90 degree, 17cm Schoeps CMC441s at Sbd into an Oade power supply then a modified Sony TCD-D5M then > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav; Mastering by Dave Usborne: Izotpoe RX Advanced Declick and Spectral Repair used manually to fix pops and digital artifacts. Editing done in Reaper V4.591/X64; Tracks cut in Audacity 2.0.5; Flac files created in Traders Little Helper

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording captures a soaring second set with standout jams like Scarlet > Fire, Space, and China Doll.
ai_review.review: The tape, taken by the legendary Doug Oade (with Jim Wise), delivers crisp, high‑fidelity sound that far outshines other sources.  Fans rave about a psychedelic, dark‑tinged second set – from a tight Phil/Lesh space jam to a bouncy Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain and an unforgettable China Doll – while the first set still holds memorable moments despite a brief amp hiccup for Jerry.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are enthusiastic (4‑5 ★) and highlight both an excellent audience recording and a high‑energy show with many praised songs, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear tape recorded by Doug Oade (and Jim Wise) using high‑end microphones; reviewers note it as a huge improvement over other sources and describe it as ‘unbelievable’ and ‘incredibly crisp.’

show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is highlighted for its dark, psychedelic depth and seamless jams (Phil/Lesh space jam, Scarlet > Fire, China Doll), while the first set still offers strong moments despite a brief amp issue during Space.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His amp went out at the start of Space, forcing the band into an impromptu jam; overall his playing is praised throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a tight space jam with Bobby before Jerry re‑joined, contributing to the set’s psychedelic flow.
